name: Imouto Paradise! ~Onii-chan to Gonin no Imouto no Ecchi Shimakuri na Mainichi~
original_name: 妹ぱらだいす！～お兄ちゃんと5人の妹のエッチしまくりな毎日～
source:
It’s summer vacation and your parents are heading overseas for work, leaving you with your 5 little sisters: typical lovestruck imouto Aya, modern tsundere Rio, timid and shy Hiyori, lively and perverted Koharu, and the bookworm Michika who's a lovable Sadist. With no distractions and ecchi happenings one after the other, how far will you go with them?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/01/01/january-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
暑假里，你的父母远赴海外工作，留下你和五个妹妹：典型的痴情少女绫、现代傲娇里约、胆怯害羞的日和、活泼变态的小春、以及可爱的书虫美智花。没有干扰，也没有接二连三发生的令人心碎的事情，你会和他们一起走多远？

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/01/01/january-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
